name: hackernews
description: Front page stories: rank, title, url, points

steps.eval: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('tr.athing')).map(tr => { const sub = tr.nextElementSibling; return { rank: tr.querySelector('.rank')?.innerText ?? '', title: tr.querySelector('.titleline a')?.innerText ?? '', url: tr.querySelector('.titleline a')?.href ?? '', points: sub?.querySelector('.score')?.innerText ?? '' }; })
